##### Project general facts

Eterna by Grid is a residential development designed around everyday comfort and wellbeing, with landscaped podium gardens and a rooftop leisure level. The collection comprises studios, larger studio residences, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, finished in a warm, natural palette of timber, stone and porcelain.

The rooftop is crowned by a swimming pool with sunken poolside beds and cabanas, a cold plunge and jacuzzi, a fully equipped gym, a co-working and multipurpose room and an outdoor space with BBQ. On the podium level, residents enjoy a yoga and meditation space, an outdoor functional training zone, a children's play area, a pet garden and landscaped gardens with seating areas. The arrival lobby features a bespoke concierge desk, while controlled access, round-the-clock security and EV chargers in selected parking spaces add everyday convenience.

Residences come with fully fitted kitchens with stone worktops and integrated appliances from Electrolux or an equivalent brand, including a combi washer dryer, bespoke fitted wardrobes in all bedrooms and porcelain-tiled bathrooms with Geberit and Grohe fittings or equivalent. District cooling and double-glazed sliding balcony doors complete the specification.

##### Location description and benefits

IMPZ, also known as Dubai Production City, is a mixed-use community in Dubai set beside Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, next to Dubai Sports City, Motor City, Arjan and Dubai Studio City. The district combines residential towers, creative offices and studios with everyday retail along its main boulevards.

Supermarkets, cafés, clinics and fitness studios are found within the community, with schools and nurseries in the surrounding neighbourhoods. Mall of the Emirates and the retail of nearby communities cover larger shopping needs, while Dubai Marina, JBR, Palm Jumeirah and Expo City Dubai are within easy reach. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road connect residents to Downtown Dubai, DIFC and Al Maktoum International Airport.

IMPZ is a freehold area open to buyers of all nationalities. Its central position between the coast and the southern districts, together with steady demand from young professionals and families, makes the community attractive for both end users and investors seeking well-connected homes with rental potential.
